start.text: You're not from around here. Good. Maybe you don't owe anyone anything yet. I'm Holt — I farm the south fields.

thief.text: Three goats this week. Someone's out there in the dark, and the sheriff's too stretched to care. Find out who, and I'll make it worth your while.

accept.text: Tracks lead into the treeline past the fence. Be careful — hungry people do desperate things. So do desperate people who aren't hungry.
